standard_prerequisites.name: Etale neighbourhood splitting off the quasi-finite part
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the decomposition U x_S X = W amal coprod V_{i,j} with purely inseparable residue fields at the v_{i,j}.

standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-finite-pullback (same chapter, NOT carded, declared external)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies (V x_Y X/V)_fin as a base change, surjective and etale.

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale criterion and the diagonal
standard_prerequisites.use: Etaleness of the constructed morphisms and the representability used throughout.

standard_prerequisites.name: Composition of representable transformation properties
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Spaces and Morphisms lemma block on representable/surjective/etale transformations (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Justifies replacing Y by the cover V.

core_obligations: Reduce to f a separated locally quasi-finite morphism of schemes via an etale cover V -> Y and the base-change identification.
For a point y with preimages x_1..x_n, pick the etale neighbourhood decomposition and form the morphism U(y, n, x_1..x_n, a, I) -> (X/Y)_fin for each subset I.
Show these morphisms etale via the finite-criterion lemma; state the surjectivity claim.

Prove surjectivity: replace T by Spec of an algebraically closed field, factor T -> Y through the residue point u, use the unique purely inseparable points of each V_{i,j} over u to write Z as the disjoint union of the Spec(k) x_U V_{i,j} for a unique subset I, and conclude the fibre product with T is nonempty.
proof_roadmap: Scheme-case reduction via etale covering, the indexed family of etale morphisms, and the algebraically-closed-field point-by-point surjectivity argument with the unique-point decomposition.
difficulty_reason: A long constructive proof: the parameterized family U(y, n, x, a, I), the reduction to algebraically closed residue fields, and the unique-purely-inseparable-point bookkeeping that pins down the subset I.
